history.recommendation_text: 47. The Board recommends that the Administration adopt a coherent approach for providing procurement services to special political missions and other entities. Human resources
history.reference_raw: A/73/5 (Vol. II), chap. II, for the year; para. 400
history.administration_response: The recommendation has been implemented. The Administration designated inter-entity operational service providers within the Secretariat, including special political missions, intended to associate services accessed from other entities with support for the proper exercise of delegated authority, including in the area of procurement.
history.board_assessment: With the United Nations reform, the approach to providing procurement services was changed. The recommendation is considered to be overtaken by events.
